services.name: Rental Information >
services.desc: We are happy to have members host birthday parties or other group parties on the club grounds during the summer season. We have set up a self-serve reservation system that allows members to check the MemberSplash calendar for availability and make a reservation for either 15 or 25 attendees. Event duration is limited to 3 hours. A reservation is required and may be made up to six weeks in advance and must be made at latest 1 week prior to your party. There is no fee for your reservation. Login to MemberSplash and then click on Make Reservations in the RESERVATIONS drop down menu to make your reservation. You may only book 6 weeks or less in advance of your party.
